messages:
rachel-sec: Heads-up: MapleHealth security questionnaire answered most sections, but they raised three follow-ups for our private deployment: (1) prove RBAC least-privilege changes since onboarding, (2) confirm KMS audit log ingestion into their SIEM and retention, (3) a recent vuln they saw from our onboarding agent (scanner) and want triage timeline. Can we consolidate answers before tomorrow's call?

david-custsec: Quick context from MapleHealth: they need evidence that service accounts created during onboarding did NOT receive cluster-admin. They also want examples of KMS:GenerateDataKey calls tied to tenant ARNs in the last 30 days. For the vuln, they saw a CVE flag from our onboarding image (scanner tag v1.4.2).

jorge-eng: For RBAC deltas we can diff rolebindings exported at two timestamps. I'll pull the previous snapshot (from 2026-02-28) and current. We should include a short CSV with columns: namespace, subject_kind, subject_name, role_ref, change_type.

leila-analyst: I'll run the RBAC diff and redact emails. Also will include a one-line proof that no SA had cluster-admin: grep for clusterrolebinding references for the onboarding SA names. Example: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name=="onboard-sa-brightshore")'`

emma-ops: On the KMS logs: we can export CloudTrail events filtered on kms.amazonaws.com for the tenant key ARNs. Proposed command:

```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-25T23:59:59Z > /tmp/maple-kms-events.json
jq '.Events[] | select(.CloudTrailEvent | contains("GenerateDataKey"))' /tmp/maple-kms-events.json > /tmp/maple-genkey-events.json
```

emma-ops: We'll also provide an export that shows the ARN in the CloudTrail event and the requestParameters.ciphertextBlob context for envelope usage.

vuln-bot: automated-scan: image-scan/agent-onboard:v1.4.2 flagged CVE-2025-3347 (medium) in package libxml2. See ticket VULN-7012.

jorge-eng: Re: the CVE: onboarding image was rebuilt last week to v1.4.3 with libxml2 patched. We need to provide the patch manifest and an assurance timeline (when fix was built, pushed, and deployed to onboarding runners).

leila-analyst: I'll attach the image build log lines and the container digest for v1.4.3. Example snippet to include for customer verification:

```text
sha256:abc123...  image:ghcr.io/redwood/onboard-agent:v1.4.3
build: 2026-03-20T04:12:08Z
patched_packages: libxml2=2.9.14-2
```

rachel-sec: MapleHealth also asked for an incident response SLA: if they report a suspected data-exposure from our side, what's our timeline and contact? We have the runbook but need a one-paragraph answer and primary contacts.

tony-sre: Short IR paragraph draft: "Redwood maintains a coordinated incident response process. For suspected customer-impacting events, we acknowledge within 1 hour, provide initial triage within 4 hours, and deliver a substantive status update within 24 hours. The on-call SRE and security lead are the primary contacts; follow-on deliverables (forensics, log exports, and remediation actions) follow the agreed timeline in the customer contract." Can someone add names/contacts for MapleHealth?

rachel-sec: I'll add contacts: on-call SRE: @tony-sre (tony@redwood.ai), security lead: @rachel-sec (rachel@redwood.ai), and the escalation manager: @leila-analyst (leila@redwood.ai). Also note we can provide encrypted log exports if they need full CloudTrail slices.

emma-ops: Action items I'm taking: 1) Produce KMS CloudTrail slice filtered to tenant ARNs and GenerateDataKey events (owner: @emma-ops). 2) Provide retention policy statement for KMS logs (owner: @emma-ops).

jorge-eng: My actions: 1) RBAC diff CSV + grep proof for no cluster-admin SAs (owner: @jorge-eng). 2) Package the container build logs and image digest showing patch (owner: @jorge-eng).

leila-analyst: I'll draft a short cover note for the questionnaire follow-ups and attach the artifacts: RBAC CSV, kms events JSON, image-build snippet, and the IR paragraph. Will redact PII and provide instructions for PGP-encrypted delivery.

sec-bot: notice: evidence-staging/3625006789 created at s3://redwood-sec/maplehealth/3625006789/ (internal).

david-custsec: MapleHealth requires evidence via SFTP with SHA512 checksum, and the SIEM team asked if we can push logs directly to their ingestion endpoint (they provided an HTTPS collector URL) 5. Can we support pushing a gzipped CloudTrail slice to their collector?

emma-ops: We can support a one-time push over HTTPS if they provide an authenticated endpoint and a certificate pin. We'll need a signed POA (transfer authorization) and approval from legal. For now we can provide the gzipped JSON via PGP over SFTP.

rachel-sec: Legal/POA note acknowledged. Leila, can you coordinate with Legal on the transfer authorization?

leila-analyst: On it. I'll open LEGAL-TX-119 and copy @david-custsec. ETA for artifacts to be ready: 6 business hours.

david-custsec: Thanks appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll review and may ask clarifying q's on the IR SLA wording.

jorge-eng: I'll post the RBAC CSV here when done. Expect it in ~90m.

emma-ops: Starting CloudTrail export now. Will attach a redacted sample in this thread within 2h.

rachel-sec: Great team. If MapleHealth pushes any more asks in the questionnaire, mark them as follow-ups and don't escalate without product/security approval.

sec-bot: reminder: create ticket SEC-SQ-907 and link evidence-staging/3625006789 for 90-day retention review."
